features.evidence: 2026-07-15: Worker resiliency fixes — H1 self-healing poll loop + process rejection/exception guards; H2 timeout-bounded provider network calls + maxJobDurationMs per-job cap; H2/M1 no-apiKey model-list redirect refusal + auto-reconnecting job_created LISTEN.
